# CLI reference

```text
usage: acr [-h] [--version]
           {review,validate,bench,models,skills,health,serve,docs,evolve} ...

Offline, model-agnostic AI code review.

positional arguments:
  {review,validate,bench,models,skills,health,serve,docs,evolve}
    review              review a unified diff
    validate            validate manifests, schemas, rule examples,
                        permissions, fixtures
    bench               run the benchmark suite
    models              list registry models or verify runtime digests
    skills              list skills
    health              check the model runtime for a profile
    serve               run the HTTP review service
    docs                generate or check reference docs in docs/generated
    evolve              produce an evidence-based improvement proposal

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## `acr review`

```text
usage: acr review [-h] [--diff DIFF] [--git-range GIT_RANGE] [--repo REPO]
                  [--paths [PATHS ...]] [--profile PROFILE] [--policy POLICY]
                  [--format FORMAT] [--out-dir OUT_DIR]
                  [--stdout {json,sarif,markdown,legacy}] [--model MODEL]
                  [--model-host MODEL_HOST] [--revision REVISION]
                  [--repository REPOSITORY] [-v]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --diff DIFF           diff file, or - for stdin (default)
  --git-range GIT_RANGE
                        review `git diff RANGE`, e.g. origin/main...HEAD
  --repo REPO           repository for --git-range (default: cwd)
  --paths [PATHS ...]   limit --git-range to these pathspecs
  --profile PROFILE     profile id or path (default: $ACR_PROFILE or balanced)
  --policy POLICY       policy id or path (default: from profile)
  --format FORMAT       comma list of json,sarif,markdown,legacy
  --out-dir OUT_DIR     write every format to this directory
  --stdout {json,sarif,markdown,legacy}
                        format to print when --out-dir is used
  --model MODEL         override the small-tier model (registry id or runtime
                        ref)
  --model-host MODEL_HOST
                        model runtime base URL (default from profile /
                        $ACR_MODEL_HOST)
  --revision REVISION   source revision for traceability
  --repository REPOSITORY
                        repository URI for traceability
  -v, --verbose         structured recovery logs on stderr
```

## `acr validate`

```text
usage: acr validate [-h] [--strict] [--skip SKIP]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --strict     treat warnings as errors
  --skip SKIP  comma list of checks to skip:
               structure,skills,models,wrappers,profiles,policies,fixtures
```

## `acr bench`

```text
usage: acr bench [-h] [--profile PROFILE] [--repeat REPEAT] [--policy POLICY]
                 [--out OUT] [--gate] [--update-manifest]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --profile PROFILE
  --repeat REPEAT    runs per case (measures stability)
  --policy POLICY    policy id (default: from profile); e.g. evaluation for
                     benchmarking
  --out OUT          write JSON (and .md) report here
  --gate             enforce policies/quality-gates/benchmarks.toml
  --update-manifest  re-record fixture checksums (protected)
```

## `acr models`

```text
usage: acr models [-h] [--ram-mb RAM_MB] [--policy POLICY] [--profile PROFILE]
                  [--pin]
                  {list,verify,recommend}

positional arguments:
  {list,verify,recommend}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ram-mb RAM_MB       recommend: memory available to the model
  --policy POLICY       recommend: policy whose license classes apply
  --profile PROFILE
  --pin                 record runtime digests for unpinned manifests
```
